summary_en: 640,000 shares (2.3% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 立会外 block trade on 2026-08-13 at ¥433/share; aggregate limit ¥277.1M; settlement same-day.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Venue Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Azuma Shipping's board authorized on 2026-08-12 the acquisition of up to 640,000 treasury shares (2.3% of the 28.19 million shares outstanding excluding treasury) via a single off-venue block trade (ToSTNeT-3) on 2026-08-13. The purchase price was set at ¥433 per share, the closing price on the TSE that day, with an aggregate ceiling of ¥277.12 million. The buy order is valid only during the designated 08:45 JST trading window. Results will be disclosed after market close. The rationale cited is to enhance shareholder value and capital efficiency whilst enabling flexible capital management in response to changing business conditions. Partial or non-execution is possible depending on market conditions.
